title: Becoming a Man through Male Power Fantasies (Jung Lecture + Dream Analysis)
summary: A 3-hour stream. It opens with a two-hour lecture on Jung's Modern Man in Search of a Soul (chapter 3, part 2), reading Theseus, Pinocchio, Orpheus and The Lion King as male power fantasies about entering the unconscious and integrating the shadow to become a man. It ends with an hour analysing viewer dreams. Along the way he links fantasy and action to having a dream physique and to high standards in self-improvement.
claims: A male power fantasy is an imagined story, taught to young men, that shows them how to become a positive masculine figure; such stories have always existed
Most anime and manga young men love are male power fantasies, which explains their appeal; the fantasy itself is neither positive nor negative, some are toxic and some are positive
Solo Leveling is a toxic male power fantasy: a weak boy is handed divine power by chance, so he is not responsible for his own development, and that will never happen to the viewer
Stories without innate mythical value get forgotten: Solo Leveling will be forgotten within about 5 years while Berserk will still be remembered in 100 years because it replicates a fundamental myth
There is no pre-existing true self to discover; you build the true self as you reach for it, like building a bridge into space, and it is the self that makes you most complete and fulfilled
A symbol is not true or false; it is valid by the effect it has on the person, which is why the symbols in his dream readings keep resonating with viewers
Man is most human when playing; children live close to the unconscious and lose their whimsy and sense of magic around age 5 or 6 when consciousness takes over

In the Theseus myth the labyrinth is the unconscious, the Minotaur is the shadow and Ariadne's thread is consciousness; you must enter, face and integrate your shadow, and the thread lets you come back with it
King Minos hid the Minotaur rather than face his own shadow, and that refusal created the cycle of sacrifices: ignoring your shadow keeps people dying
Pinocchio shows that being born male is not being a man: becoming a man takes work and a journey out into the world, not staying home playing video games
Shadow work can be lost: Pinocchio is led by the trickster cat and fox to Pleasure Island, where boys devoted to material pleasure turn into donkeys and never become men
Pinocchio becomes a real boy through responsibility and honesty; you cannot lie your way to a true self, and lying and self-indulgence pull you away from it
Orpheus failed because he was too masculine: overconfident and fixed on action, he refused grief and vulnerability; the masculine alone is not enough and must integrate the feminine (anima)
In The Lion King the land of light is the conscious and the shadow land the unconscious; Mufasa ignored the shadow (Scar) and that caused his death, so a man who ignores his shadow pays the price
Simba with Timon and Pumbaa is the eternal child (puer aeternus): his body grows while he stays a cub, and a woman pulls him out because he must become a man to have her
The shadow is the traits you avoid facing; it is unique to each person, so no book or ebook can tell you how to do shadow work, and the first step is accepting the unconscious
His own shadow was mostly lust; as a young man it steered his life until he faced it, understood its motives and now consciously resists it
The part of you that you resist dies and the part you feed grows and becomes you
Without his shadow work he would be a single man in his 30s with senseless relationships, unhappy
Left alone too long the shadow petrifies; he has met people in their 50s and 60s who ignored their issues all their lives and whom no therapy can now help
Most neuroses in modern secular people come from a lack of spirituality, not from religion; people with no named religion still follow nameless creeds
The goal of Jungian psychology is to become your own analyst; as long as someone else must read the symbols for you, you stay psychologically a child
Consuming theory and guidance without acting is useless: what is woven by day the night unravels; teachings only take form when followed by action
Becoming a man includes mistakes; whoever waits to be perfect before starting never starts, and it is normal to suck for a long time, as with lifting
To find a meaning not yet in your life you must do things you have never done
Self-improvement educators breed clones of themselves because it is easy; a real guide can only be the thread and cannot fight your Minotaur for you
He built a strong individuality early after seeing friend groups where everyone copied everyone; it makes social life harder but strangers often quiz his wife about him afterwards
Identity is built with strong boundaries, strong preferences and strong principles, like a castle you decorate yourself
Always have a dream physique: of 10 men who fantasize about one and 10 who do not, the dreamers will get better results and their physique will skew toward what they dream of
Turning your dream physique into your real physique proves to you that you can achieve anything, because you dragged something from imagination into reality
To be more productive, write down what you have to do; making a list is a potent deliberate act
A good therapist gives action items and checks next session whether you did them; one who only talks is just there because you pay
Being delusional is fine if you truly believe and act on it; obsession with the goal makes you study it and build an action plan, which is why it succeeds
Mishima went from a cerebral boy with no body to a man of physical culture by building a deliberate plan around his fantasy
Treating yourself as a spectator to whom life happens is psychological childishness; people who act on their lives tend to be happier
He suspects modern society discourages independence because independent people need less government, and he refuses to sell people dependence
The ego is a poor master: ego-driven people are insecure; the self must rule while the ego is kept in check, and since the ego grows with vitality, individuation is lifelong
Young people must educate their will to adapt to society; in the second half of life one must let go and turn inward toward the unconscious
Men who start the gym only for women do improve but often plateau; many later get drawn into training for the right reasons once they see other parts of life improve
Older people tend to be either empty husks who invested only in consciousness or calm, wise people who integrated the unconscious and do not fear death
Bushido and Stoicism independently told men to meditate on their death daily, showing a shared collective unconscious
Old Disney movies are better than modern ones because they still told the fundamental myths children need
Social anxiety may be an environmental mismatch from living among millions; in a mountain village of 50 people it might vanish
Everything that acts is actual: in psychology, whether something is scientifically real matters less than its effect
Replacing Africa's animist spiritual structures with imported religion and democracy removed the unconscious foundation of those societies and contributes to their instability
Humans are mystic apes; making psychology purely scientific loses mysticism, and he argues other animals have no unconscious
Stoicism appeals mostly to people who are not naturally stoic; he is stoic by default so he studies Nietzsche and Jung for emotion
If a girl is on the fence she is not that into you; keep hope if you want but do not let it stop you finding someone who wants you
End a date with a gesture, such as a kiss or holding hands, that introduces the next date
Public patronage that lets artists focus on their art produces more beautiful societies
Fiction can serve personal development as well as philosophy, because you relate to characters and it is easier to read
Violent dreams where you do terrible things are not a sign of a coming break; they are the unconscious showing you your shadow, so resist shame
Muggers follow you until you reach dark, empty places; if followed, stay where there is light and people and they usually give up
Recurring infidelity dreams come from conscious fantasizing about exes or coworkers; stop feeding those fantasies, which is control rather than unhealthy repression
He also has cheating dreams; they ruin his day with shame, and feeling bad rather than good on waking is the healthy sign
Dreams of escaping and running mean avoiding confrontation; the unconscious is telling you to confront
As a child of divorce he holds that two separated parents beat two who fight constantly, though best is choosing a partner well
Jung rejects the Freudian causal approach that every neurosis comes from childhood; adult problems also create neuroses
He lost friends in the Bataclan terrorist attack in Paris
He avoids One Piece videos for fear of copyright strikes, after a lawsuit with the Japanese company that owned Baki took two years to settle
viewer_questions: how to come to terms with impermanence
is being delusional on purpose productive
hope for a girl on the fence
morality of being a prison guard
